title: Abstrakt mavzularda fikr yuritish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida abstrakt mavzuda (masalan, baxt, adolat, muvaffaqiyat) 2–3 daqiqa davomida tushunchani aniqlab, faraziy misollar keltirib, umumlashtirish va cheklovlardan to‘g‘ri foydalanib, izchil tuzilgan fikr bildira olasiz.

scenes.title: Mavhum savollarga tayyormisiz?
board: Lesson: Reasoning about abstract topics
(Abstrakt mavzularda fikr yuritish)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ikki daqiqa to‘xtamasdan gapirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun bu ko‘nikmani eng qiyin savollarga qo‘llaymiz: baxt nima, adolat nima, muvaffaqiyat omadmi yoki mehnatmi. Dars oxirida bunday mavzuda tushunchani aniqlab, faraz qilib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan umumlashtirib, izchil fikr bildira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time you learned to keep talking for two minutes without stopping. Today we raise the bar: what do you say when the question is not about your hometown, but about fairness, freedom or success?
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar ikki daqiqa to‘xtamasdan gapirishni o‘rgandingiz. Bugun darajani ko‘taramiz: savol shahringiz haqida emas, balki adolat, erkinlik yoki muvaffaqiyat haqida bo‘lsa, nima deysiz?

scenes.title: Aniq va mavhum savol
board: Concrete: What do you do at weekends?
Abstract: Does leisure make us happier?
Abstract = ideas, not things

examples.t: Is it ever right to break the law?
examples.uz: Qonunni buzish qachondir to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkinmi?

scenes.say_native: Avval farqni ko‘raylik. Aniq savol narsalar haqida: dam olish kunlari nima qilasiz? Mavhum savol esa g‘oyalar haqida: dam olish bizni baxtliroq qiladimi? IELTS speaking imtihonining uchinchi qismida va jiddiy suhbatlarda aynan shunday savollar beriladi. Bu yerda so‘z boyligi bilan birga fikrni tartib bilan qurish ham baholanadi.
scenes.say: A concrete question asks about things and events. An abstract question asks about ideas: is it ever right to break the law? There is no single correct answer, so the quality of your reasoning is what counts.
scenes.say_uz: Aniq savol narsalar va voqealar haqida so‘raydi. Mavhum savol g‘oyalar haqida: qonunni buzish qachondir to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkinmi? Yagona to‘g‘ri javob yo‘q, shuning uchun fikrlash sifatingiz muhim.

scenes.title: Mavhum otlar oilasi
board: -dom: freedom, wisdom
-ness: fairness, awareness
-ity: equality, responsibility
-ence/-ance · -ship: independence, tolerance, citizenship

examples.t: Equality does not always mean fairness.
examples.uz: Tenglik har doim ham adolatni anglatmaydi.

examples.t: Wisdom comes with experience.
examples.uz: Donolik tajriba bilan keladi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: mavhum otlar. Ular ko‘pincha qo‘shimchadan taniladi: -dom, freedom; -ness, fairness; -ity, equality; -ence va -ance, independence, tolerance; -ship, citizenship. O‘zbek tilidagi “-lik” qo‘shimchasiga o‘xshaydi: erkinlik, tenglik. Farqi shundaki, inglizchada qo‘shimcha har xil, uni so‘z bilan birga yodlash kerak.
scenes.say: Equality does not always mean fairness. Wisdom comes with experience. Notice the endings: free becomes freedom, fair becomes fairness, equal becomes equality, independent becomes independence.
scenes.say_uz: Tenglik har doim ham adolatni anglatmaydi. Donolik tajriba bilan keladi. Qo‘shimchalarga e’tibor bering: free freedom ga, fair fairness ga, equal equality ga, independent independence ga aylanadi.

scenes.title: Artikl: umumiy va aniq ma’no
board: General idea → no article: Freedom matters.
Specific → the: the freedom of the press
a/an + kind: a deep sense of loyalty

examples.t: Happiness is hard to define.
examples.uz: Baxtni ta’riflash qiyin.

examples.t: The happiness of a child depends on stability.
examples.uz: Bolaning baxti barqarorlikka bog‘liq.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun bu joyda xato ko‘p. Mavhum ot umumiy ma’noda kelsa, artikl qo‘yilmaydi: Happiness is hard to define. Aniq kimningdir baxti haqida gapirsak, odatda of bilan, the kerak: the happiness of a child. Sifat bilan bir turini aytsak, a ham bo‘ladi: a deep sense of loyalty.
scenes.say: Happiness is hard to define. That is the general idea, so no article. The happiness of a child depends on stability. That is a specific case, so we use the. And she showed a remarkable degree of courage.
scenes.say_uz: Baxtni ta’riflash qiyin. Bu umumiy g‘oya, shuning uchun artikl yo‘q. Bolaning baxti barqarorlikka bog‘liq. Bu aniq holat, shuning uchun the ishlatamiz. U ajoyib darajada jasorat ko‘rsatdi.

scenes.title: Mavhum otlar bilan kollokatsiyalar
board: raise awareness · pose a threat
strike a balance between X and Y
draw a distinction between X and Y
gain insight into · make progress

examples.t: We need to strike a balance between security and privacy.
examples.uz: Xavfsizlik va shaxsiy hayot o‘rtasida muvozanat topishimiz kerak.

examples.t: It is worth drawing a distinction between wealth and well-being.
examples.uz: Boylik va farovonlik o‘rtasida farq qo‘yishga arziydi.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum ot o‘z fe’li bilan keladi. Raise awareness, xabardorlikni oshirish; pose a threat, tahdid solish; strike a balance, muvozanat topish; draw a distinction, farq qo‘yish. O‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilsangiz, “make a balance” yoki “do progress” chiqadi, bu noto‘g‘ri. Kollokatsiyani birgalikda yodlang.
scenes.say: We need to strike a balance between security and privacy. It is worth drawing a distinction between wealth and well-being. Campaigns raise awareness, and climate change poses a threat to coastal cities.
scenes.say_uz: Xavfsizlik va shaxsiy hayot o‘rtasida muvozanat topishimiz kerak. Boylik va farovonlik o‘rtasida farq qo‘yishga arziydi. Kampaniyalar xabardorlikni oshiradi, iqlim o‘zgarishi esa qirg‘oq shaharlariga tahdid soladi.

scenes.title: Artikl va fe’l xatolari
board: ✗ The freedom is the most important value.
✓ Freedom is the most important value.
✗ We did a big progress.
✓ We made great progress.
scenes.say_native: Ikki tipik xato. Birinchisi, umumiy ma’nodagi mavhum otdan oldin the qo‘yish: “The freedom is the most important value”. Rus tilini biladiganlar ham, o‘zbekcha so‘zlovchilar ham bu yerda adashadi. To‘g‘risi: Freedom is the most important value. Ikkinchisi, progress bilan do ishlatish va “a” qo‘yish. Progress sanalmaydi va make bilan keladi: we made great progress.
scenes.say: Freedom is the most important value. No article, because we mean freedom in general. And progress is uncountable, so we say we made great progress, not we did a big progress.
scenes.say_uz: Erkinlik eng muhim qadriyat. Artikl yo‘q, chunki umuman erkinlikni nazarda tutyapmiz. Progress esa sanalmaydi, shuning uchun we made great progress deymiz, we did a big progress emas.

scenes.title: Artikl va kollokatsiya
board: 1 (The / –) justice should be blind.
2 (The / –) independence of the courts is vital.
3 Schools should ___ awareness of mental health.
4 It is hard to ___ a balance between work and life.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta topshiriq. Birinchi va ikkinchi gapda the kerakmi yoki artiklsiz qoldiramizmi? Esda tuting: umumiy tushuncha artiklsiz, aniq va of bilan kelgan narsa the bilan. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchi gapda bo‘sh joyga qaysi fe’l mos keladi? Pauza qiling, javobni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: One: blank justice should be blind. The, or no article? Two: blank independence of the courts is vital. Three: Schools should blank awareness of mental health. Four: It is hard to blank a balance between work and life.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: adolat ko‘r bo‘lishi kerak. The kerakmi yoki artiklsizmi? Ikki: sudlarning mustaqilligi hayotiy muhim. Uch: maktablar ruhiy salomatlik haqida xabardorlikni ... kerak. To‘rt: ish va hayot o‘rtasida muvozanat ... qiyin.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Justice should be blind. (general)
2 The independence of the courts (specific + of)
3 raise · 4 strike
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: artiklsiz, justice umumiy tushuncha. Ikkinchi: the, chunki aniq narsa, sudlarning mustaqilligi, va undan keyin of keladi. Uchinchi: raise awareness. Increase awareness ham uchraydi, lekin raise eng tabiiy. To‘rtinchi: strike a balance. Find a balance ham to‘g‘ri, faqat make a balance demang.
scenes.say: One: Justice should be blind, no article. Two: The independence of the courts is vital, because of the of phrase. Three: raise awareness. Four: strike a balance, or find a balance.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: artiklsiz. Ikki: the, chunki of iborasi bor. Uch: raise awareness. To‘rt: strike a balance yoki find a balance.

scenes.title: Tushunchani aniqlab olish
board: By X, I mean ...
If we define X as ..., then ...
X in the sense of ... rather than ...
It depends on what we mean by X.

examples.t: By success, I mean a sense of purpose rather than a large salary.
examples.uz: Muvaffaqiyat deganda katta maoshni emas, maqsad hissini nazarda tutyapman.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum savolga javobni tushunchani aniqlashdan boshlash foydali, chunki “success” bir kishi uchun pul, boshqasi uchun oila. “By success, I mean…” deysiz va suhbat chegarasini o‘zingiz belgilaysiz. “It depends on what we mean by freedom” ham yaxshi boshlanish, lekin keyin albatta ma’noni tanlang, aks holda bu qochish bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: By success, I mean a sense of purpose rather than a large salary. If we define freedom as the absence of control, then no one is truly free. Defining your terms first makes everything that follows clearer.
scenes.say_uz: Muvaffaqiyat deganda katta maoshni emas, maqsad hissini nazarda tutyapman. Agar erkinlikni nazoratning yo‘qligi deb ta’riflasak, unda hech kim chinakam erkin emas. Atamalarni avval aniqlash keyingi hamma narsani tushunarliroq qiladi.

scenes.title: Mavhum ot + that-gap
board: the idea / belief / assumption that + clause
the notion that money equals success
the question of whether ...

examples.t: The assumption that money brings happiness is rarely questioned.
examples.uz: Pul baxt keltiradi degan taxmin kamdan-kam shubha ostiga olinadi.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum ot ko‘pincha butun fikrni o‘ziga oladi: the idea that, the belief that, the assumption that, the notion that. Undan keyin to‘liq gap keladi. O‘zbekchada “… degan fikr” deymiz va fikr oldin keladi, inglizchada esa ot oldin, fikr keyin. Savol uchun: the question of whether. Bu tuzilma mavhum nutqni ixcham va aniq qiladi.
scenes.say: The assumption that money brings happiness is rarely questioned. The notion that hard work always pays off is comforting, but naive. Then there is the question of whether talent can be taught.
scenes.say_uz: Pul baxt keltiradi degan taxmin kamdan-kam shubha ostiga olinadi. Mehnat har doim o‘z samarasini beradi degan tasavvur taskin beradi, lekin sodda. Iste’dodni o‘rgatish mumkinmi, degan savol ham bor.

scenes.title: Faraziy fikrlash: ikkinchi shart
board: If + past simple, would + verb
If everyone earned the same, would people work hard?
If I were in charge, I would ...

examples.t: If money didn't exist, people would still compete for status.
examples.uz: Agar pul bo‘lmaganida, odamlar baribir maqom uchun raqobatlashardi.

examples.t: If I were a teacher, I would abolish homework.
examples.uz: Agar men o‘qituvchi bo‘lganimda, uy vazifasini bekor qilardim.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: faraziy fikrlash. Mavhum mavzuda biz tez-tez “agar shunday bo‘lsa-chi?” deb so‘raymiz. Asosiy vosita ikkinchi shart gap: if dan keyin past simple, natijada would. O‘tgan zamon shakli bu yerda vaqtni emas, haqiqatdan uzoqlikni bildiradi, xuddi o‘zbekchadagi “bo‘lganida, qilardim” kabi. If I were, ya’ni hamma shaxs uchun were, rasmiy va xavfsiz variant.
scenes.say: If money didn't exist, people would still compete for status. If everyone earned the same, would people still work hard? If I were in charge, I would invest in libraries. The past form signals distance from reality, not past time.
scenes.say_uz: Agar pul bo‘lmaganida, odamlar baribir maqom uchun raqobatlashardi. Agar hamma bir xil maosh olsa, odamlar baribir qattiq ishlarmidi? Agar men rahbar bo‘lganimda, kutubxonalarga sarmoya kiritardim. O‘tgan zamon shakli o‘tgan vaqtni emas, haqiqatdan uzoqlikni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Suppose, imagine, what if
board: Suppose / Supposing + past: Suppose we abolished exams.
Imagine a world where ... / Let's say ...
What if + past: What if nobody voted?

examples.t: Suppose we abolished exams. How would universities choose students?
examples.uz: Faraz qilaylik, imtihonlarni bekor qildik. Universitetlar talabalarni qanday tanlardi?

examples.t: Imagine a world where nobody ever lied.
examples.uz: Hech kim hech qachon yolg‘on gapirmaydigan dunyoni tasavvur qiling.

scenes.say_native: Faraz qilishning boshqa yo‘llari nutqni jonli qiladi. Suppose yoki supposing va past simple: suppose we abolished exams. What if ham shunday: what if nobody voted? Imagine a world where… tinglovchini fikr tajribangizga taklif qiladi, let’s say esa og‘zaki nutqda juda tabiiy. Bular bilan g‘oya amalda qanday ishlashini sinab ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say: Suppose we abolished exams. How would universities choose students? Imagine a world where nobody ever lied. Would it be a kinder place, or a more painful one? Let's say you found a wallet full of cash. What would you do?
scenes.say_uz: Faraz qilaylik, imtihonlarni bekor qildik. Universitetlar talabalarni qanday tanlardi? Hech kim hech qachon yolg‘on gapirmaydigan dunyoni tasavvur qiling. U mehribonroq joy bo‘larmidi yoki og‘riqliroqmi? Aytaylik, siz naqd pulga to‘la hamyon topdingiz. Nima qilardingiz?

scenes.title: Rasmiyroq faraz: were to, were it not for
board: If X were to + verb (unlikely future)
Were it not for X, ... (= if X didn't exist)
Had it not been for X, ... (past)

examples.t: If governments were to ban cars, cities would change overnight.
examples.uz: Agar hukumatlar mashinalarni taqiqlasa, shaharlar bir kechada o‘zgarardi.

examples.t: Were it not for the internet, remote work would be impossible.
examples.uz: Internet bo‘lmaganida, masofaviy ish imkonsiz bo‘lardi.

scenes.say_native: C1 darajasiga xos tuzilmalar. “If X were to” kelajakdagi ehtimoli past farazni bildiradi: if governments were to ban cars. “Were it not for” bu “agar … bo‘lmaganida”. O‘tmish uchun: had it not been for my teacher. Bularni har gapda ishlatmang, lekin bitta-ikkitasi o‘rinli ishlatilsa, nutqingiz ancha yetuk eshitiladi.
scenes.say: If governments were to ban cars, cities would change overnight. Were it not for the internet, remote work would be impossible. Had it not been for my teacher, I would never have studied abroad.
scenes.say_uz: Agar hukumatlar mashinalarni taqiqlasa, shaharlar bir kechada o‘zgarardi. Internet bo‘lmaganida, masofaviy ish imkonsiz bo‘lardi. Ustozim bo‘lmaganida, men hech qachon chet elda o‘qimagan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Faraziy gapdagi xatolar
board: ✗ If everyone would earn the same, ...
✓ If everyone earned the same, ...
✗ Were it not the internet, ...
✓ Were it not for the internet, ...
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: if qismiga would qo‘yish. “If everyone would earn the same” noto‘g‘ri, would faqat natija qismida: if everyone earned the same, people would… Ikkinchi xato: “were it not for” dan for ni tushirib qoldirish, bu turg‘un ibora. Uchinchisi: suppose dan keyin would qo‘yish. Suppose we abolished deng.
scenes.say: If everyone earned the same, people would work less. Not if everyone would earn. And were it not for the internet, with for. Keep would in the result, not in the condition.
scenes.say_uz: Agar hamma bir xil maosh olsa, odamlar kamroq ishlardi. If everyone would earn emas. Va were it not for the internet, for bilan. Would ni shart qismiga emas, natija qismiga qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Farazni tuzing
board: 1 If robots (do) all the work, people (have) more free time.
2 Suppose we (can) read minds. What (happen)?
3 ___ it not for vaccines, many more children would die.
scenes.say_native: Uchta topshiriq. Birinchi va ikkinchi gapda qavsdagi fe’llarni faraziy shaklga qo‘ying: shart qismida o‘tgan shakl, natijada would. Uchinchi gapda bo‘sh joyga bitta so‘z kerak, u bugun o‘rgangan inversiyamiz. Gaplarni to‘liq, ovoz chiqarib ayting. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: One: If robots, do, all the work, people, have, more free time. Two: Suppose we, can, read minds. What, happen? Three: blank it not for vaccines, many more children would die.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: agar robotlar barcha ishni qilsa, odamlarda ko‘proq bo‘sh vaqt bo‘lardi. Ikki: faraz qilaylik, biz fikrlarni o‘qiy olardik. Nima bo‘lardi? Uch: emlash bo‘lmaganida, ko‘proq bolalar nobud bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 If robots did all the work, people would have more free time.
2 Suppose we could read minds. What would happen?
3 Were it not for vaccines, ...
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: if robots did, people would have. Ikkinchi: suppose we could read minds, what would happen? Can ning o‘tgan shakli could, u o‘zi modal, shuning uchun would could demaymiz. Uchinchi: were. Agar “if” bilan aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz: if it were not for vaccines. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, inversiya rasmiyroq.
scenes.say: One: If robots did all the work, people would have more free time. Two: Suppose we could read minds. What would happen? Three: Were it not for vaccines, or, less formally, if it weren't for vaccines.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: agar robotlar barcha ishni qilsa, odamlarda ko‘proq bo‘sh vaqt bo‘lardi. Ikki: faraz qilaylik, fikrlarni o‘qiy olardik. Nima bo‘lardi? Uch: Were it not for vaccines yoki kamroq rasmiy if it weren't for vaccines.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ijtimoiy tarmoqlarsiz dunyo
board: Speakers: Dana and Omar
Question: Would we be happier without social media?
scenes.say_native: Endi suhbatni tinglang. Dana va Umar ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bo‘lmaganida baxtliroq bo‘lardikmi, degan savolni muhokama qilmoqda. Ular tushunchani qanday aniqlashini, qanday faraz qilishini va qarshi misolga qanday javob berishini kuzating. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Dana: Would we be happier without social media? Omar: It depends on what we mean by happier. Calmer, perhaps. Dana: Suppose it disappeared tomorrow. Wouldn't people just feel lonely? Omar: Some would, at first. But if we spent those hours with real friends, I think we'd be better off. Dana: Were it not for social media, though, I'd never have found my job. Omar: Fair point. So maybe the tool isn't the problem; the habit is.
scenes.say_uz: Dana: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarsiz baxtliroq bo‘lardikmi? Umar: Baxtliroq deganda nimani nazarda tutishimizga bog‘liq. Balki xotirjamroq. Dana: Faraz qilaylik, ertaga ular yo‘qoldi. Odamlar shunchaki yolg‘iz qolmasmidi? Umar: Ba’zilari, avvaliga. Ammo o‘sha soatlarni haqiqiy do‘stlar bilan o‘tkazsak, menimcha, ahvolimiz yaxshiroq bo‘lardi. Dana: Lekin ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bo‘lmaganida, men hech qachon ishimni topmagan bo‘lardim. Umar: To‘g‘ri gap. Demak, muammo vositada emas, odatda.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1 How does Omar define “happier”?
2 What is Dana's personal counterexample?
3 What is Omar's final conclusion?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, Umar “happier” so‘zini qanday aniqlashtiradi? Ikkinchi, Dana o‘z hayotidan qanday qarshi misol keltiradi va qaysi tuzilmani ishlatadi? Uchinchi, Umarning yakuniy xulosasi nima? To‘liq gap bilan, inglizcha javob bering. Kerak bo‘lsa, qayta tinglang.
scenes.say: One: How does Omar define happier? Two: What is Dana's personal counterexample? Three: What is Omar's final conclusion?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Umar happier ni qanday ta’riflaydi? Ikki: Dananing shaxsiy qarshi misoli nima? Uch: Umarning yakuniy xulosasi nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Calmer, perhaps
2 She found her job through social media.
3 The habit, not the tool, is the problem.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Umar “happier” ni “calmer”, ya’ni xotirjamroq deb toraytiradi. Ikkinchi: Dana ishini ijtimoiy tarmoq orqali topgan, buni “were it not for social media” bilan aytdi. Uchinchi: muammo vositada emas, odatda. E’tibor bering, ikkala so‘zlovchi ham bugungi uch vositani ishlatdi: tushunchani aniqlash, faraz va qarshi misol.
scenes.say: One: he narrows it down to calmer. Two: she found her job through social media. Three: the problem is the habit, not the tool. Notice how the conversation moved from a definition to a hypothesis to a counterexample.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: u buni xotirjamroq deb toraytiradi. Ikki: Dana ishini ijtimoiy tarmoq orqali topgan. Uch: muammo vositada emas, odatda. Suhbat ta’rifdan farazga, so‘ng qarshi misolga qanday o‘tganiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Umumlashtirish
board: tend to + verb: People tend to ...
on the whole · by and large · as a rule
generally speaking · in most cases
There is a tendency for X to ...

examples.t: People tend to value what they have worked for.
examples.uz: Odamlar mehnat qilib erishgan narsasini qadrlashga moyil.

examples.t: By and large, older generations are more cautious with money.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, katta avlod pulga ehtiyotkorroq munosabatda.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: umumlashtirish va cheklash. Mavhum mavzuda biz odamlar, jamiyat haqida umumiy gaplar aytamiz. Lekin “all people” deyish xavfli. Shuning uchun yumshoq umumlashtiruvchilar kerak: tend to, on the whole, by and large, as a rule, generally speaking. Bular “odatda, ko‘pincha” degan ma’noni beradi va istisnolar borligini tan oladi.
scenes.say: People tend to value what they have worked for. By and large, older generations are more cautious with money. As a rule, the more choice we have, the harder it is to decide.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar mehnat qilib erishgan narsasini qadrlashga moyil. Umuman olganda, katta avlod pulga ehtiyotkorroq munosabatda. Odatda, tanlov qancha ko‘p bo‘lsa, qaror qilish shuncha qiyin.

scenes.title: Fikrni cheklash
board: to some extent · up to a point
arguably · it could be argued that
may / might / can · seem / appear
in many cases, though not all

examples.t: Money can buy happiness, up to a point.
examples.uz: Pul ma’lum chegaragacha baxt sotib olishi mumkin.

examples.t: Arguably, the greatest threat is indifference.
examples.uz: Aytish mumkinki, eng katta tahdid befarqlikdir.

scenes.say_native: Qualifying, ya’ni fikrni cheklash, umumlashtirishning juftidir. To some extent va up to a point “ma’lum darajada” degani. Arguably kuchli fikrni ehtiyotkorlik bilan aytishga yordam beradi. Modal fe’llar may, might, can va seem, appear fe’llari ham fikrni yumshatadi. Bu zaiflik emas, balki fikrlash halolligi belgisi.
scenes.say: Money can buy happiness, up to a point. Arguably, the greatest threat to democracy is indifference. It could be argued that schools teach obedience rather than thinking. Qualifying a claim makes it harder to attack.
scenes.say_uz: Pul ma’lum chegaragacha baxt sotib olishi mumkin. Aytish mumkinki, demokratiyaga eng katta tahdid befarqlikdir. Maktablar fikrlashdan ko‘ra itoatkorlikni o‘rgatadi, deb aytish mumkin. Fikrni cheklash unga qarshi chiqishni qiyinlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Miqdorni aniq tanlang
board: all → most → many → some → few → none
Not all X are Y.
There are, of course, exceptions.

examples.t: Not all rich people are happy.
examples.uz: Hamma boylar ham baxtli emas.

examples.t: Most people, though certainly not all, want stability.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik, albatta hamma emas, barqarorlikni xohlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Eng oddiy cheklash usuli: miqdor so‘zini to‘g‘ri tanlash. All o‘rniga most, many yoki some deng. O‘zbekchada “hamma boylar ham baxtli emas” deymiz. Inglizchada “all rich people are not happy” desangiz, ma’no noaniq bo‘lib qoladi, shuning uchun “not all” ni gap boshiga qo‘ying: Not all rich people are happy.
scenes.say: Not all rich people are happy. Most people, though certainly not all, want stability. Few would argue that education is unimportant. There are, of course, exceptions.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma boylar ham baxtli emas. Ko‘pchilik, albatta hamma emas, barqarorlikni xohlaydi. Ta’limni muhim emas deb bahslashadiganlar kam. Albatta, istisnolar bor.

scenes.title: Haddan oshgan umumlashtirish
board: ✗ All young people are lazy nowadays.
✓ Young people are often portrayed as lazy, but ...
✗ Everybody knows that money is everything.
✓ Many people seem to equate money with success.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xavf: haddan oshgan umumlashtirish. “All young people are lazy” yoki “everybody knows” suhbatdoshni darhol qarshi chiqishga undaydi va imtihonda sizni sodda ko‘rsatadi. Tuzatish: “are often portrayed as”, “many people seem to”. Ikkinchi variantda siz boshqalarning fikrini tasvirlaysiz va o‘z bahoyingizga joy qoldirasiz.
scenes.say: Young people are often portrayed as lazy, but the reality is more complicated. Many people seem to equate money with success. These versions describe a view instead of declaring a universal truth.
scenes.say_uz: Yoshlar ko‘pincha dangasa sifatida tasvirlanadi, lekin haqiqat murakkabroq. Ko‘pchilik pulni muvaffaqiyat bilan tenglashtirganga o‘xshaydi. Bu variantlar universal haqiqat e’lon qilish o‘rniga qarashni tasvirlaydi.

scenes.title: Haddan oshgan ehtiyotkorlik
board: ✗ It might perhaps possibly be true in some cases.
✓ This is often true, though not always.
One hedge per claim is usually enough.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi xavf teskari tomonda: haddan oshgan ehtiyotkorlik. “It might perhaps possibly be true” degan gapdan tinglovchi sizning fikringizni umuman topa olmaydi. Odatda bitta cheklovchi yetarli. Avval aniq fikr ayting, keyin chegarasini ko‘rsating: “This is often true, though not always.” Ehtiyotkor, ammo pozitsiyasi aniq so‘zlovchi eng ishonchli eshitiladi.
scenes.say: It might perhaps possibly be true in some cases. That says nothing. Compare: This is often true, though not always. Make a clear claim, then mark its limits. One hedge per claim is usually enough.
scenes.say_uz: Bu ba’zi hollarda balki ehtimol to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu hech narsa demaydi. Solishtiring: bu ko‘pincha to‘g‘ri, lekin har doim emas. Aniq fikr ayting, keyin chegarasini ko‘rsating. Odatda bitta cheklovchi yetarli.

scenes.title: Gapni yumshating
board: 1 Rich people are selfish.
2 Social media destroys friendships.
3 Exams show how intelligent you are.
scenes.say_native: Uchta haddan oshgan umumlashtirish. Har birini bugungi vositalar bilan yumshating: tend to, not all, to some extent, arguably yoki modal fe’l. Lekin pozitsiyangiz aniq qolsin, faqat bitta cheklov yetarli. Har biriga bittadan variant ayting. Keyin namunalar bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Qualify these sweeping claims, but keep a clear position. One: Rich people are selfish. Two: Social media destroys friendships. Three: Exams show how intelligent you are.
scenes.say_uz: Bu keskin fikrlarni cheklang, lekin pozitsiyangiz aniq qolsin. Bir: boylar xudbin. Ikki: ijtimoiy tarmoqlar do‘stlikni buzadi. Uch: imtihonlar qanchalik aqlli ekaningizni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1 Not all rich people are selfish, although wealth can ...
2 Social media can weaken some friendships ...
3 Exams measure intelligence only up to a point.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “Not all rich people are selfish, although wealth can make it easier to ignore others.” Ikkinchi: “Social media can weaken some friendships, particularly when it replaces face-to-face contact.” Uchinchi: “Exams measure intelligence only up to a point; they arguably reward memory more than creativity.” Har birida bitta cheklov va aniq fikr bor.
scenes.say: Not all rich people are selfish, although wealth can make it easier to ignore others. Social media can weaken some friendships, particularly when it replaces face-to-face contact. Exams measure intelligence only up to a point.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma boylar ham xudbin emas, garchi boylik boshqalarga e’tibor bermaslikni osonlashtirsa-da. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ba’zi do‘stliklarni zaiflashtirishi mumkin, ayniqsa yuzma-yuz muloqot o‘rnini egallasa. Imtihonlar aqlni faqat ma’lum chegaragacha o‘lchaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ehtiyotkor ohang
board: to some ˈextent ↘↗ (fall-rise = “but...”)
it could be ˈargued /ðət/ ...
ˈarguably — stress on AR

examples.t: To some extent, yes. But ...
examples.uz: Ma’lum darajada, ha. Lekin ...

scenes.say_native: Endi talaffuz. “To some extent” ni ko‘pincha pastga tushib, keyin biroz ko‘tariladigan ohang bilan aytamiz, bu “lekin…” keladi degan ishora. “It could be argued that” da that kuchsiz, ðət deb aytiladi. Arguably so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: AR-gu-ab-ly. Urg‘uni oxiriga qo‘ymang.
scenes.say: To some extent, yes. But not entirely. Listen to the fall-rise on extent. It could be argued that, with a weak that. And arguably, with the stress on the first syllable.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lum darajada, ha. Lekin to‘liq emas. Extent so‘zidagi pastlab-ko‘tariluvchi ohangni tinglang. It could be argued that, kuchsiz that bilan. Va arguably, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda.

scenes.title: Mavhum argument tuzilishi
board: 1 Position  2 Definition
3 Reason + concrete example
4 Counterpoint  5 Qualified conclusion
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: mavhum argumentni tuzish. Oddiy, ammo ishonchli qolip: avval pozitsiya, keyin kerak bo‘lsa tushunchani aniqlash, so‘ng sabab va aniq misol, keyin qarshi fikr va nihoyat cheklangan xulosa. Bu qolip sizni chalg‘ishdan saqlaydi. Oldingi darsdagi ikki daqiqalik nutq rejasi bilan solishtiring: u yerda voqea aytdingiz, bu yerda esa fikrni isbotlaysiz.
scenes.say: A reliable shape for an abstract answer: state your position, define the key term, give a reason with a concrete example, acknowledge a counterpoint, and end with a qualified conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Mavhum javob uchun ishonchli shakl: pozitsiyangizni ayting, asosiy atamani aniqlang, aniq misol bilan sabab keltiring, qarshi fikrni tan oling va cheklangan xulosa bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: Nutqdagi yo‘l ko‘rsatkichlar
board: Let me start by ... · That brings me to ...
To put it another way, ...
Where this argument breaks down is ...
So, all things considered, ...

examples.t: That brings me to the question of responsibility.
examples.uz: Bu meni mas’uliyat masalasiga olib keladi.

scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda tinglovchi orqaga qaytib o‘qiy olmaydi, shuning uchun yo‘l ko‘rsatkichlar kerak. Let me start by… boshlanish; that brings me to… keyingi fikrga o‘tish; to put it another way… boshqacha ifodalash; where this argument breaks down is… zaif joyni ko‘rsatish; all things considered… xulosa.
scenes.say: Let me start by defining fairness. That brings me to the question of responsibility. To put it another way, freedom without rules is chaos. Where this argument breaks down is in poorer countries.
scenes.say_uz: Adolatni ta’riflashdan boshlay. Bu meni mas’uliyat masalasiga olib keladi. Boshqacha aytganda, qoidalarsiz erkinlik tartibsizlikdir. Bu dalil kambag‘alroq mamlakatlarda ishlamay qoladi.

scenes.title: Mavhumdan aniqqa
board: Take, for instance, ...
To give you a concrete example, ...
Abstract claim → real case → back to the idea

examples.t: Take, for instance, a nurse on a low salary who loves her job.
examples.uz: Masalan, ishini yaxshi ko‘radigan, kam maosh oladigan hamshirani olaylik.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum nutqning katta xavfi: hamma narsa havoda qoladi. Shuning uchun mavhum fikrdan keyin aniq misolga tushing: “Take, for instance…” yoki “To give you a concrete example…”, keyin yana g‘oyaga qayting. Misol: kam maosh oladigan, ishini sevadigan hamshira o‘zini muvaffaqiyatli his qiladi. Demak, muvaffaqiyat qisman ma’no bilan bog‘liq.
scenes.say: Success is not only about money. Take, for instance, a nurse on a low salary who loves her job. She may well consider herself successful. So success is, at least in part, about meaning.
scenes.say_uz: Muvaffaqiyat faqat pul haqida emas. Masalan, ishini yaxshi ko‘radigan, kam maosh oladigan hamshirani olaylik. U o‘zini muvaffaqiyatli deb hisoblashi mumkin. Demak, muvaffaqiyat hech bo‘lmaganda qisman ma’no bilan bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Qarshi fikrni tan olish
board: One might object that ...
Admittedly, ... · That said, ...
Even so, I would maintain that ...

examples.t: Admittedly, luck plays a role. That said, effort decides what we do with it.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri, omad rol o‘ynaydi. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, u bilan nima qilishimizni mehnat hal qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Kuchli so‘zlovchi qarshi fikrni o‘zi aytadi va unga javob beradi. One might object that… ya’ni kimdir e’tiroz bildirishi mumkin. Admittedly, to‘g‘ri; that said, shunday bo‘lsa-da; even so, I would maintain that, baribir men … deb hisoblayman. Bu ketma-ketlik sizni xolis ko‘rsatadi va pozitsiyangizni yo‘qotmaydi. O‘zbekchadagi “to‘g‘ri, lekin…” qolipiga juda yaqin.
scenes.say: Admittedly, luck plays a role. That said, effort decides what we do with it. One might object that some people never get a chance. Even so, I would maintain that effort matters more over a lifetime.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, omad rol o‘ynaydi. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, u bilan nima qilishimizni mehnat hal qiladi. Kimdir ba’zilarga hech qachon imkoniyat berilmaydi, deb e’tiroz bildirishi mumkin. Baribir, men umr davomida mehnat muhimroq deb hisoblayman.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ According to me, ...
✓ In my view, ... / As I see it, ...
✗ In my opinion, I think that ...
✓ I think that ... (one is enough)
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato o‘zbek tilidan keladi. Birinchisi, “menimcha” ni “according to me” deb tarjima qilish. According to boshqalarning fikri uchun: according to the report. O‘zingiz uchun: in my view, as I see it. Ikkinchisi, “in my opinion, I think” degan ikki karra fikr. Bittasi yetarli.
scenes.say: In my view, effort matters more. As I see it, the question is badly framed. Not according to me. And choose one: in my opinion, or I think, never both together.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, mehnat muhimroq. Mening nazarimda, savol noto‘g‘ri qo‘yilgan. According to me emas. Va bittasini tanlang: in my opinion yoki I think, ikkalasini birga emas.

scenes.title: Argumentni tartiblang
board: A Admittedly, some talented people never succeed.
B I'd argue that talent is overrated.
C So, on balance, persistence matters more.
D Take Edison, who failed hundreds of times.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap aralashtirib berilgan. Ularni bugungi qolip bo‘yicha tartiblang: avval pozitsiya, keyin aniq misol, so‘ng qarshi fikr va oxirida xulosa. Harflarni to‘g‘ri tartibda ayting va har bir gapdagi qaysi so‘z sizga yordam berganini tushuntiring. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: Put the four sentences in the best order. A: Admittedly, some talented people never succeed. B: I'd argue that talent is overrated. C: So, on balance, persistence matters more. D: Take Edison, who failed hundreds of times.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni eng yaxshi tartibda joylashtiring. A: to‘g‘ri, ba’zi iste’dodli odamlar hech qachon muvaffaqiyatga erishmaydi. B: iste’dod ortiqcha baholanadi, deb aytgan bo‘lardim. C: demak, umuman olganda, qat’iyat muhimroq. D: yuzlab marta muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan Edisonni olaylik.

scenes.title: Javob
board: B → D → A → C
position → example → counterpoint → conclusion
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, D, A, C. Avval pozitsiya: talent is overrated. Keyin aniq misol: Edison. So‘ng qarshi fikr: admittedly, ba’zi iste’dodlilar muvaffaqiyatga erishmaydi. Va xulosa: on balance, persistence matters more. On balance iborasi “hammasini tortib ko‘rganda” degani, u xulosaning cheklangan ekanini bildiradi.
scenes.say: The order is B, D, A, C. Position, example, counterpoint, conclusion. On balance signals that you have weighed both sides before deciding.
scenes.say_uz: Tartib: B, D, A, C. Pozitsiya, misol, qarshi fikr, xulosa. On balance ikkala tomonni tortib ko‘rib, keyin qaror qilganingizni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: imtihondagi javob
board: Examiner + candidate (Aziza)
Question: Is it more important to be honest or to be kind?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Imtihon oluvchi Azizaga mavhum savol beradi: rostgo‘ylik muhimroqmi yoki mehribonlik? Aziza qanday boshlashini, tushunchani qanday aniqlashini, qanday faraz qilishini va qanday xulosa qilishini kuzating. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Examiner: Is it more important to be honest or to be kind? Aziza: That's a difficult one. It depends partly on what we mean by honest. If we mean never telling a lie, then I'd say kindness matters more. Suppose a friend asked whether you liked her wedding dress. Would brutal honesty help anyone? That said, in public life, honesty is arguably essential. So, on balance, I'd say kindness in private life, honesty in public life.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon oluvchi: rostgo‘y bo‘lish muhimroqmi yoki mehribon bo‘lish? Aziza: Bu qiyin savol. Bu qisman rostgo‘y deganda nimani nazarda tutishimizga bog‘liq. Agar hech qachon yolg‘on gapirmaslikni nazarda tutsak, men mehribonlik muhimroq der edim. Faraz qilaylik, dugonangiz to‘y libosi yoqdimi deb so‘radi. Shafqatsiz rostgo‘ylik kimgadir yordam berarmidi? Shunday bo‘lsa-da, jamoat hayotida rostgo‘ylik, aytish mumkinki, zarur. Demak, umuman olganda, shaxsiy hayotda mehribonlik, jamoat hayotida rostgo‘ylik.

scenes.title: Tahlil savollari
board: 1 How does Aziza define “honest”?
2 What hypothetical situation does she use?
3 How does she qualify her final answer?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, Aziza “honest” so‘zini qanday aniqlaydi? Ikkinchi, u qanday faraziy vaziyatni keltiradi? Uchinchi, yakuniy javobini qanday cheklaydi? Javob berishda Azizaning iboralarini aynan takrorlashga harakat qiling. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni qayta tinglang.
scenes.say: One: How does Aziza define honest? Two: What hypothetical situation does she use? Three: How does she qualify her final answer?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Aziza honest ni qanday ta’riflaydi? Ikki: u qanday faraziy vaziyatdan foydalanadi? Uch: yakuniy javobini qanday cheklaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Never telling a lie
2 A friend asking about her wedding dress
3 Kindness in private life, honesty in public life
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “never telling a lie”. Ikkinchi: dugonaning to‘y libosi haqidagi savoli, bu suppose bilan berilgan faraz. Uchinchi: u javobni ikki sohaga bo‘ladi: shaxsiy hayotda mehribonlik, jamoat hayotida rostgo‘ylik. Bu oddiy “ha yoki yo‘q” emas, chegaralangan, yetuk xulosa.
scenes.say: One: never telling a lie. Two: a friend asking about her wedding dress. Three: she splits the answer: kindness in private life, honesty in public life. That is a qualified conclusion, not a simple yes or no.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: hech qachon yolg‘on gapirmaslik. Ikki: dugonaning to‘y libosi haqidagi savoli. Uch: u javobni ikkiga bo‘ladi: shaxsiy hayotda mehribonlik, jamoat hayotida rostgo‘ylik. Bu oddiy ha yoki yo‘q emas, cheklangan xulosa.

scenes.title: Vaqt yutish va savolni ochish
board: That's a difficult one to answer briefly.
I've never really thought about it, but ...
There are two ways of looking at this.

examples.t: There are two ways of looking at this.
examples.uz: Bunga ikki xil qarash mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum savol berilganda bir-ikki soniya o‘ylash tabiiy. Jim qolmang, tabiiy ibora bilan to‘ldiring: “That’s a difficult one to answer briefly”, “I’ve never really thought about it, but…”. “There are two ways of looking at this” ham vaqt, ham tayyor tuzilma beradi. Lekin bunday iborani har javob boshida takrorlamang.
scenes.say: That's a difficult one to answer briefly. I've never really thought about it, but I suppose fairness matters more than equality. There are two ways of looking at this.
scenes.say_uz: Bunga qisqa javob berish qiyin. Bu haqda hech qachon chuqur o‘ylamaganman, lekin menimcha, adolat tenglikdan muhimroq. Bunga ikki xil qarash mumkin.

scenes.title: Yakuniy nutq vazifasi
board: Can money buy happiness?
Define · hypothesise · qualify · counterpoint
Speak for 90 seconds
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Savol: pul baxt sotib ola oladimi? To‘qson soniya gapiring. Rejangiz: pozitsiya, tushunchani aniqlash, bitta faraz yoki aniq misol, qarshi fikr va cheklangan xulosa. Telefoningizga yozib oling, keyin o‘zingizni tinglang. Pauza davomida rejani tuzing.
scenes.say: Final task. Can money buy happiness? Speak for ninety seconds. Define happiness, use at least one hypothetical, qualify your claims, acknowledge a counterpoint and finish with a balanced conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Pul baxt sotib ola oladimi? To‘qson soniya gapiring. Baxtni ta’riflang, kamida bitta faraz ishlating, fikrlaringizni cheklang, qarshi fikrni tan oling va muvozanatli xulosa bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: By happiness, I mean long-term well-being ...
If I suddenly became rich, ...
Admittedly, ... · On balance, ...
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang va o‘zingiznikiga solishtiring. Unda pozitsiya bor: pul faqat ma’lum chegaragacha yordam beradi. Ta’rif bor: by happiness, I mean. Faraz bor: if I suddenly became rich. Qarshi fikr bor: admittedly. Va xulosa on balance bilan cheklangan. Sizning javobingizda shu besh qismdan nechtasi bor edi?
scenes.say: By happiness, I mean long-term well-being rather than a moment of pleasure. Money helps up to a point: it removes fear about rent and food. But if I suddenly became rich, would my relationships improve? Probably not. Admittedly, poverty makes happiness very hard. On balance, though, money buys security, not happiness itself.
scenes.say_uz: Baxt deganda bir lahzalik lazzatni emas, uzoq muddatli farovonlikni nazarda tutaman. Pul ma’lum chegaragacha yordam beradi: ijara va oziq-ovqat haqidagi qo‘rquvni yo‘qotadi. Lekin birdan boyib ketsam, munosabatlarim yaxshilanarmidi? Ehtimol, yo‘q. To‘g‘ri, qashshoqlik baxtni juda qiyinlashtiradi. Lekin umuman olganda, pul baxtning o‘zini emas, xavfsizlikni sotib oladi.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: Abstract nouns: articles + collocations
Hypotheses: if + past · suppose · were it not for
Generalise + qualify: tend to · up to a point
Structure: position → example → counterpoint → conclusion
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: mavhum otlarni umumiy ma’noda artiklsiz ishlating va ularning kollokatsiyalarini biling. Ikkinchi: faraz uchun ikkinchi shart, suppose, what if va were it not for. Uchinchi: tend to va by and large bilan umumlashtiring, up to a point va arguably bilan cheklang, lekin pozitsiyani yo‘qotmang. To‘rtinchi: pozitsiya, misol, qarshi fikr, xulosa.
scenes.say: To sum up: use abstract nouns accurately, test ideas with hypotheses, generalise carefully and qualify your claims, and give every answer a clear shape from position to conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: mavhum otlarni to‘g‘ri ishlating, g‘oyalarni farazlar bilan sinang, ehtiyotkorlik bilan umumlashtiring va fikrlaringizni cheklang, har bir javobga pozitsiyadan xulosagacha aniq shakl bering.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: Is success luck or effort? (3 minutes)
Success: definition + 2 hypotheticals + 3 qualifiers + counterpoint
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: “Muvaffaqiyat omadmi yoki mehnatmi?” degan savol bo‘yicha uch daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Mezon: muvaffaqiyat tushunchasini aniqlang, kamida ikkita faraziy gap ishlating, kamida uchta cheklovchi ibora va bitta qarshi fikr bo‘lsin, “according to me” bo‘lmasin. Keyingi darsda nominalizatsiya va akademik uslubni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: talk for three minutes on the question: is success luck or effort? Define success, use at least two hypotheticals and three qualifiers, and answer one counterargument. Next time, we turn to academic writing.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: muvaffaqiyat omadmi yoki mehnatmi degan savol bo‘yicha uch daqiqa gapiring. Muvaffaqiyatni ta’riflang, kamida ikkita faraz va uchta cheklovchi ishlating, bitta qarshi dalilga javob bering. Keyingi safar akademik yozuvga o‘tamiz.

homework_uz: “Is success luck or effort?” (Muvaffaqiyat omadmi yoki mehnatmi?) savoli bo‘yicha 3 daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Mezon: muvaffaqiyat tushunchasini aniqlang, kamida 2 ta faraziy gap (if + past, suppose, were it not for), kamida 3 ta cheklovchi ibora (tend to, up to a point, arguably va h.k.), bitta qarshi fikr va unga javob bo‘lsin; javob pozitsiya → misol → qarshi fikr → xulosa tuzilishiga ega bo‘lsin.

options: The freedom is the most important value.
Freedom is the most important value.
A freedom is the most important value.
Freedoms is the most important value.
quiz.why_uz: Mavhum ot umumiy ma’noda artiklsiz ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: We need to ___ a balance between security and privacy.
quiz.why_uz: Turg‘un kollokatsiya: strike a balance (find a balance ham mumkin).

quiz.q: If everyone ___ the same salary, would people still work hard?
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi shartda if qismida past simple, would emas.

quiz.q: ___ it not for the internet, remote work would be impossible.
quiz.why_uz: Inversiya: Were it not for ... = If it were not for ...

quiz.q: Suppose we ___ read minds. What would happen?
quiz.why_uz: Suppose dan keyin faraz uchun o‘tgan shakl: could.

options: Young people might perhaps possibly be lazy.
Young people are sometimes portrayed as lazy, but this is often unfair.
Everybody knows young people are lazy.
quiz.why_uz: Bitta cheklov va aniq pozitsiya; qolganlari haddan oshgan umumlashtirish yoki haddan oshgan ehtiyotkorlik.
Up to a point = ma’lum chegaragacha.

quiz.q: Which phrase correctly gives YOUR opinion?

quiz.q: Which word is stressed on the FIRST syllable?
What usually comes after “Admittedly, ...” in a balanced argument?
options: A concession, then a return to your position
quiz.why_uz: Admittedly qarshi fikrni tan oladi, keyin that said / even so bilan o‘z pozitsiyangizga qaytasiz.
